references.text: The city of refuge was to protect the manslayer from the avenger of blood until he had stood trial.
The avenger of blood has the right to kill the manslayer when they meet.
Anyone who had killed someone had to stay within the boundaries of the city of refuge to be safe.
The avenger of blood could pursue the manslayer, and the cities of refuge were established to prevent innocent blood from being shed.
The cities of refuge in Joshua provide protection from the avenger of blood, and the manslayer must remain there until the high priest dies.
Blood revenge was an accepted practice in Israel, and the king could intervene to stop it.
